derivation: Derived GEOMETRICALLY from the real TY2025 f1040sd.pdf (IRS fillable form): for every entry, the widget /Rect of the field (read with pypdf) was matched against the printed line labels extracted with `pdftotext -bbox` on the blank form; a field is assigned to the line whose printed label sits on the same row (widget y-center within ~6pt of the label row) and, for table columns, whose x-band matches the printed column. Checkbox on-states were read from each widget's /AP /N appearance keys with pypdf. TY2025 printed text routes Form 8949 Box A totals to line 1b ('Totals for all transactions reported on Form(s) 8949 with Box A or Box G checked') and Box D totals to line 8b; the packet lists every 1099-B transaction on Form 8949, so the short-term/long-term totals land on 1b/8b and 1a/8a stay blank. Part I/II table column x-bands verified: (d) 288-359.25, (e) 360-431.25, (g) 432-503.25, (h) 504-576. Line 6/14 fields (f1_21/f1_42) are the narrow parenthesized fields on their label rows. Page 2: line 17 Yes = c2_1[0] (/1, label row 'Yes. Go to line 18.'), No = c2_1[1] (/2); line 20 Yes = c2_2[0] (/1), No = c2_2[1] (/2); line 22 Yes = c2_3[0] (/1), No = c2_3[1] (/2). The QOF question checkboxes (c1_1) are deliberately NOT in this map: the engine models no QOF disposition, so the question stays unanswered (see packet manifest notes).
